locations.title: Cucco Ranch
locations.description:
**Objective:** Dodge the Cuccos flying in the ranch for 30 seconds. Each level increases the number and size of Cuccos.

**Level 1 (Egg):**  
_Cost:_ 20 Rupees  
_Reward:_ 40 Rupees

**Level 2 (Chick):**  
_Cost:_ 30 Rupees  
_Reward:_ 60 Rupees

**Level 3 (Rooster):**  
_Cost:_ 50 Rupees  
_Reward:_ 150 Rupees and a [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214573)

**Level 4 (Endless):**  
_Special:_ As the name implies, this level is endless-ish.  
_Cost:_ 10 Rupees
_Reward:_ 100 Rupees per 100 seconds  
_Special reward:_ Lasting 1,000 seconds rewards 3,000 Rupees

locations.title: Rupee Rush
locations.description:
**Objective:** Collect as many Rupees as you can within 30 seconds. Remaining time is not displayed in game. Ending closer to 30 seconds multiplies the amount, while going over 30 seconds nullifies it.  
**Cost:** 50 Rupees  
**Reward:** The first time the player collects over 100 Rupees, he receives a [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214649)

locations.title: Hyrule Hotfoot
locations.description:
**Objective:** Race to the other racing bro behind [Rosso's House](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214588) within the time limit.  
**Cost:** 20 Rupees.
**Rewards:**
- Level 1 (75 seconds): 100 Rupees
- Level 2 (65 seconds): [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214714)
- Level 3 (beat your previous time): 300 Rupees

locations.title: Treacherous Tower
locations.description:
**Objective:** Defeat all enemies in the room to advance; complete all rooms to win the level. Further levels have harder enemies and more rooms. When replaying a level, beating it with a lower time will yield additional Rupees.

**Beginner (5 rooms):**  
_Cost:_ 100 Rupees  
_Reward:_ 300 Rupees

**Intermediate (15 rooms):**  
_Cost:_ 200 Rupees  
_Reward:_ 1,000 Rupees and a [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215193)

**Advanced (50 rooms):**  
_Cost:_ 300 Rupees  
_Reward:_ 5,000 Rupees  
_Other rewards:_ Beating the level for the first time upgrades the [Lamp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214555) to the Super Lamp. Beating it a second time upgrades the [Net](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214571) to the Super Net.

locations.title: Fortune's Choice
locations.description:
**Objective:** Open 3 treasure chests, among a choice of 15. You keep whatever you open.  
**Cost:** 200 Rupees  
**Treasure distribution:**
- 1x [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215206) (turns into a Golden Rupee once opened)
- 2x Golden Rupee (300)
- 3x Silver Rupee (100)
- 3x Red Rupee (20)
- 3x Green Rupee (1)
- 1x Monster Guts
- 1x Monster Horn
- 1x Monster Tail

locations.title: Octoball Derby
locations.description:
**Objective:** Hit 30 balls into the fields, breaking pots to gain points.  
**Cost:** 50 Rupees  
**Reward:** 1 Rupee per point scored  
**Special reward:** A [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215217), the first time the player scores above 100 points.

locations.title: Graveyard
locations.description: Interact with the middle gravestone to reveal the secret passage to the [Sanctuary Dungeon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214556)

locations.title: Mother Maiamai
locations.description:
**Note:** Requires the [Bomb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214598) to access the cavern.

Speaking with her allows the player to collect lost Maiamais. For every 10 maiamais collected, Mother Maiamai can upgrade one gear from [Ravio's Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214595) that the player _owns_. See each gear for their upgrades.

locations.title: Secret Cavern
locations.description: **Location:** Against the wall between the two pillars; use a [Bomb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214598) to reveal the entrance.

locations.title: Bouldering Guy
locations.description: **Location:** On a platform; Merge Wall when exiting the moving platforms cave to reach him.

locations.title: Runaway Item Seller
locations.description:
**Location:** Hidden in a secret cavern; use a [Bomb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214598) to blow up the wall between the two small rocks.  
**Quest:** Bring him a [Scoot Fruit](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215143) to gain 100 Rupees.

locations.title: Great Rupee Fairy
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a caver, behind a large boulder, which must be blown using a [Big Bomb Flower](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215219).  
Can be given 50 or 200 Rupees to fully heal the player and release a few fairies. After donating a total of 3,000 Rupees, gives an [Empty Bottle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215222).

locations.title: Song Riddle
locations.description:
♪ A smart thief fears the boss's wrath!

♪ This accursed life sets me back to thievin'!

**Note:** Unavailable until [Osfala](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215235) is rescued.

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** In a chest, at the end of a secret cavern; using a [Bomb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214598), blow up the northern wall to reveal.

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** In a chest, on the platform. Access by climbing the ice cave (going west at the crossroads) and Wall Merging from the platform to the west.

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** In a cavern, behind a large boulder. Use a [Big Bomb Flower](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215219) to blow it up.

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for solving the puzzle; requires the [Sand Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214602) and the [Tornado Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214596).

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** Cut down the flowers to reveal a secret hatch, leading to a puzzle room. Solve to to access the Rupee.

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** [Swamp Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215331) - Floor B1, small western room. Throw a [Bomb](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214598) at the activator to spawn the chest.

locations.title: Golden Rupee
locations.description: **Location:** [Ice Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215336), Floor 1; after activating the rotating platforms, walk underneath the stairs to access.

locations.title: Lamp
locations.description:
**Location:** In the chest, right at the entrance of the [Sanctuary Dungeon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214556)  
**Utility:** Lights up torches, melts ice and damages enemies.  
**Note:** Beating the [Treacherous Tower](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215192)'s Advanced level for the first time upgrades it to the _Super Lamp_, which deals 8 times more damage to enemies.

locations.title: Ravio's Bracelet
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by Ravio after completing the [Sanctuary Dungeon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214556).  
**Utility:** Enables Wall Merging upon completing the [Eastern Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214576).

locations.title: Pendant of Courage
locations.description: **Location:** Given by Princess Zelda after completing the [Sanctuary Dungeon](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214556).

locations.title: Hint Glasses
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by the [Fortune-Teller](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214560).  
**Utility:** Reveals Hint Ghosts.

locations.title: Shield
locations.description:
**Location:** Sold by the [Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214565) for 50 Rupees.  
**Utility:** Blocks all incoming damage from a given direction.

locations.title: Net
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by the [Bee Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214570).  
**Utility:** Allows for catching bugs, fruits, fairies, and more. Must be then stored in a Bottle.  
**Note:** Beating the [Treacherous Tower](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215192)'s Advanced level for the second time upgrades it to the _Super Net_, which deals 8 times more damage.

locations.title: Bell
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by Irene when crossing the bridge after completing [Eastern Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214576).  
**Utility:** Allows warping between Weather Vanes.

locations.title: Pouch
locations.description:
**Location:** On the tree stumpt, after completing [Eastern Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214576).  
**Utility:** Allows the player to map an item to the 'X' button.

locations.title: Smooth Gem
locations.description:
**Location:** Sold by the [Street Merchant](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214567) for 200 Rupees.  
**Utility:** After visiting the [Zora Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214585), bring it back to gain [Zora's Flippers](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214607).

locations.title: Pegasus Boots
locations.description:
**Location:** After visiting the [Zora Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214585), surprise the Shady Guy from behind through Wall Merging.  
**Utility:** Allows for bashing into trees and pillars, revealing hidden items.

locations.title: Power Glove
locations.description:
**Location:** Speak with Rosso in his [house](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214588).  
**Utility:** Allows picking up and moving small rocks.

locations.title: Zora's Flippers
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by Oren after bringing her the [Smooth Gem](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214586).  
**Utility:** Allows swimming.

locations.title: Letter in a Bottle
locations.description:
**Location:** At the bottom of the river; use [Zora's Flippers](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214607) to access.  
**Utility:** Give to the [Milk Bar](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214757) Owner to gain the [Premium Milk](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214759).

locations.title: Premium Milk
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by the Milk Bar Owner after reading the [Letter in a Bottle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214684).  
**Utility:** Traded for an [Empty Bottle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214769) to the [Bouldering Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214768)

locations.title: Pendant of Power
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for defeating the boss of the [Tower of Hera](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214593)

locations.title: Pendant of Wisdom
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for defeating the boss of [House of Gales](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214674)

locations.title: Scoot Fruit
locations.description:
**Location:** Sold by the [Lakeside Item Seller](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215142) for 50 Rupees.  
**Utility:** Teleports the player back to the dungeon's entrance.

locations.title: Foul Fruit
locations.description:
**Location:** Sold by the [Lakeside Item Seller](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215142) for 30 Rupees.  
**Utility:** Stuns nearby enemies.

locations.title: Shield
locations.description:
**Location:** Sold by the [Lakeside Item Seller](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215142) for 100 Rupees.  
**Utility:** Blocks all damage in a given direction.

locations.title: Master Sword
locations.description:
**Location:** Deep in the Lost Woods; solve the maze riddles to access.  
**Requirements:**
- [Pendant of Courage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214559)
- [Pendant of Power](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215121)
- [Pendant of Wisdom](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215141)

locations.title: Big Bomb Flower
locations.description:
**Location:** In [Bomb-Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215218)'s garden. Access must be purchased for 200 Rupees.  
**Utility:** Blows up large cracked boulders.  
**Note:** This bomb isn't carried; it must be pushed to destination without taking damage. When consumed, another grows in this spot.

locations.title: Titan's Mitt
locations.description:
**Location:** [Desert Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215257) - 1st floor, central room. Use the [Sand Rod](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214602) to build sand bridges across the pillars, and Wall Merge behind the sandfall to a chest.  
**Utility:** Move large rocks.

locations.title: Bee Badge
locations.description:
**Location:** Traded by the [Bee Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214570) for a Golden Bee (one can be purchased [here](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215304)).  
**Utility:** Befriends bees, making them attack the enemies instead.

locations.title: Hylian Shield
locations.description:
**Location:** [Turtle Rock](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215326) - Floor B1, central room. Kill all 4 Red Mages to spawn a chest on a pillar.  
**Utility:** Blocks magical attacks.

locations.title: Blue Mail
locations.description:
**Location:** [Swamp Palace](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215331) - Floor B1, central room. Lower the water level to 1 bar, then jump in the central pond and swim to the northern room.  
**Utility:** Halves damage taken.

locations.title: Stamina Scroll
locations.description:
**Location:** [Ice Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215336) - Floor B3, central room. On the higher platform on the right; drop down from the floor above.  
**Utility:** Increases maximum stamina.

locations.title: Triforce of Courage
locations.description:
**Location:** Automatically granted once saving all 7 Sages:
- [Impa](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215330)
- [Rosso](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215340)
- [Irene](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215262)
- [Gulley](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215300)
- [Seres](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215311)
- [Osfala](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215235)  
- [Oren](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215335)

**Utility:** Progresses the game.

locations.title: Red Mail
locations.description:
**Location:** [Lorule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215342) - Floor 4, central room. Turns off all torched to reveal the hidden path to the south.
  
**Utility:** Halves incoming damage; stacks with [Blue Mail](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215333) for a total of 75% damage reduction.

locations.title: Golden Bee
locations.description:
**Location:** Sold by the [Mysterious Man](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215303) for 888 Rupees.

Can be traded to the [Bee Guy](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214570) for the [Bee Badge](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215305)

locations.title: Stuck Turtle
locations.description: **Location:** High up on the wall; Wall Merge from the western cliff to dislodge it.

locations.title: Attacked Turtle
locations.description: **Location:** In the middle of the water; defeat the nearby enemies to save it.

locations.title: Stranded Turtle
locations.description: **Location:** On its back, on the shore; use the [Titan's Mitt](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215258) to throw it back into the water.
